items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She was on a tour that I did in Japan for All Art promotion.

ctx.x: Yeah, now that you mention it. Yeah. I forgot about Jeanie.

She did several records. Then we did a tour. She was on a tour that I did in Japan for All Art promotion. There have been a lot. At Manhattan – who was there? Again, I can’t think of names off the top of my head. There were so many people, so many.
When you mention – of course, any pianists coming through your lessons and your tutelage are going to benefit greatly. You mentioned folks like Terence Blanchard. There’s David Sanchez.
